subject: Risk & Compliance
title: Why Cyber Risk Is Business Risk
description: Learn Why Cyber Risk Is Business Risk in one minute.

hook.text: A single ransomware attack shut down Colonial Pipeline for six days. Gas prices spiked across the US.

buildup.text: Cyber risk isn't just an IT problem. It's a business risk that can halt revenue, destroy trust, and invite lawsuits.

discovery.text: The average cost of a data breach in 2023 was $4.45 million. Some breaches cost billions.

twist.text: Most boards still treat cybersecurity as a tech expense, not a strategic risk. Attackers know this.

climax.text: Companies that treat cyber risk like any other business risk invest more, detect faster, and recover sooner.

punchline.text: Cyber risk is business risk. Treat it that way or pay.
